origins.section: 7.1. A Payment Crosses Four Parties, and Each Hop Is a Link of Its Own
7.2. An Approval Holds the Money in the Dual-Message Flow and Moves It in the Single-Message Flow
7.3. Settlement Moves One Net Amount per Institution, Days After the Purchases
7.5. What Undoes a Transaction Depends on How Far It Has Gone

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-device-id: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-device-id: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-device-id: 7.1 says every hop rebuilds the message and passes on only the fields its specification defines, so a tag the network's specification does not carry reaches the issuer nowhere (the lesson uses field 48, the quiz field 63; the principle is the same).
recorded.prompt:q-stuck-batch: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stuck-batch: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stuck-batch: 7.2 says an approval with no clearing leaves approvals and nothing else, and the issuer drops the uncleared hold after some days; the summary in 7.6 says without the clearing record the hold lapses and nothing is paid.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-day: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-day: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-day: 7.3 says the network moves one net amount per member: 41,200.00 owed to the bank less 38,950.00 it owes is a 2,250.00 receipt.
recorded.prompt:q-never-delivered: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-never-delivered: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-never-delivered: 7.5's table puts a disputed cleared purchase under a chargeback sent by the issuer through the network's dispute process in clearing; a refund is the other route, but the merchant does not answer.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-device-id:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-device-id:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-device-id:b: 7.1's example has the acquirer putting the tag in and losing it at the network's specification, not on the acquirer's own link; partly true only in that the device ID does not arrive.
recorded.prompt:q-device-id:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-device-id:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-device-id:c: 7.1 says every hop rebuilds the message, so the network does not forward it as it arrived.
recorded.prompt:q-device-id:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-device-id:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-device-id:d: 7.1 says a private field gets across only if the next link's specification defines it, so it does not travel end to end.
recorded.prompt:q-stuck-batch:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stuck-batch:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stuck-batch:b: 7.3 says settlement adds up each member's cleared transactions, and 7.6 says nothing is paid without clearing, so an approval alone pays no one.
recorded.prompt:q-stuck-batch:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stuck-batch:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stuck-batch:c: 7.2 says an approved 0100 only places a hold and no money moves until clearing.
recorded.prompt:q-stuck-batch:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-stuck-batch:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-stuck-batch:d: 7.2 says the issuer drops the uncleared hold rather than posting it.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-day:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-day:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-day:b: 7.3 says there is one net amount per member, not two gross sums.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-day:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-day:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-day:c: 7.3 and 7.6 say no purchase appears in a transfer of its own.
recorded.prompt:q-settlement-day:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-settlement-day:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-settlement-day:d: 7.3 says the 05xx messages let the two ends agree on totals and move no money themselves.
recorded.prompt:q-never-delivered:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-never-delivered:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-never-delivered:b: 7.5 says the acquirer sends a reversal, and for an 0100 it works only until clearing, so nine days after clearing it is too late.
recorded.prompt:q-never-delivered:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-never-delivered:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-never-delivered:c: Partly true: 7.5 does say the acquirer sends reversals, but it also says a reversal sent after clearing falls outside the window and the purchase still stands.
recorded.prompt:q-never-delivered:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-never-delivered:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-never-delivered:d: 7.5 says the issuer sends the chargeback and the acquirer answers it with a representment.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
